## Description
Run `jest` will throw below error in `react-native@0.58+` in flow project (typescript project is ok).
```
TypeError: require(...).getViewManagerConfig is not a function
```

2. `npm install`.
3. `git checkout ReactNative0.58.1`.
4. run `jest -u`.
